subject: planner: remove code of the hint nth_plan - 1 (#63803)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent `8840daf4824ba05e29aab682b53885cdc922f750`: removes `PlanCounterTp` and all forced-plan enumeration plumbing (plan counting, `rebuildChildTasks`, `PlanCounterDisabled`) and drops both Volcano/Cascades optimizer use of `StmtHints.ForceNthPlan` (the `nth_plan()` hint). Changes are largely mechanical signature updates plus deletion of code paths that were only reachable when forcing a specific plan; with the prior default (`ForceNthPlan=-1`), the removed `Dec/Empty/IsForce` branches were no-ops, so normal plan selection/costing/txn/privilege semantics appear unchanged. Checked `ae3d6ac..upstream/master` for follow-up fixes mentioning `nth_plan`/`ForceNthPlan`/`PlanCounterTp` and found none.
